1. We have an array of ExtensionObjects being decoded via `Array_decodeBinary`
2. One element's `ExtensionObject_decodeBinary` is called
3. It decodes a NodeId with a STRING or BYTESTRING identifier type (so `NodeId_deleteMembers` will free the string data)
4. The encoding byte is `UA_EXTENSIONOBJECT_ENCODED_XML` (value 2)
5. `dst->encoding = XML`, `dst->content.encoded.typeId = binTypeId` (moves the typeId)
6. `ByteString_decodeBinary(&dst->content.encoded.body)` fails (e.g., not enough data)
7. `UA_NodeId_deleteMembers(&dst->content.encoded.typeId)` frees the string data in the typeId
8. Returns error
9. `Array_decodeBinary` calls `UA_Array_delete(*dst, i+1, type)` which calls `ExtensionObject_deleteMembers`
10. `ExtensionObject_deleteMembers` sees `encoding == XML` and calls `NodeId_deleteMembers(&p->content.encoded.typeId)` AGAIN - DOUBLE FREE!
